body:
## Pull request overview

Removes a type-safety bypass in the CRM example stack configuration by deleting an unnecessary `as any` cast, ensuring `defineStack` enforces the config shape at compile time. Also updates the project roadmap to reflect completion of the task.

**Changes:**
- Remove trailing `as any` cast from `examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts` so `defineStack` type-checking is enforced.
- Mark the corresponding roadmap item as completed under P0.1.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts | Drops the `as any` cast at the `defineStack` call site to restore compile-time validation. |
| ROADMAP.md | Adds a checked roadmap entry indicating the CRM config type-safety fix is complete. |
